definitions.explanation: The northeastern region of Honshu, comprising the six prefectures of Aomori, Iwate, Miyagi, Akita, Yamagata, and Fukushima. Also used for the northeast compass direction in general.

examples.english: It snows a lot in the Tohoku region.

examples.japanese: {東北|とうほく}{新幹線|しんかんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仙台|せんだい}→仙台：30730_sendai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Sendai on the Tohoku Shinkansen.

examples.japanese: {東北|とうほく}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧や⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The Tohoku region has many places rich in hot springs and nature.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧ (east) + ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧ (north), pronounced とうほく. Refers primarily to the Tohoku region of northeastern Honshu, but can also indicate the northeast compass direction in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東北|とうほく}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: Tohoku region
- {東北|とうほく}{新幹線|しんかんせん}: Tohoku Shinkansen
- {東北|とうほく}{弁|べん}: Tohoku dialect
- {東北|とうほく}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from Tohoku

CULTURAL NOTE:
The region was severely affected by the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and tsunami. Known for its harsh winters, distinctive dialects, and traditional foods such as ⟦{牛|ぎゅう}タン→牛タン：30735_gyuutan⟧ (Sendai beef tongue) and きりたんぽ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧: Kanto region (around Tokyo)
- ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧: Kansai region (around Osaka)
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: Hokkaido (separate northern island)
